record.what_it_does: Work management platform for tasks, docs, goals and team collaboration.
record.auth_notes: Personal API token (pk_..., sent raw in Authorization header, never expires) for individual use; OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant for multi-user apps (Bearer token, users pick Workspaces).
record.access_notes: Personal tokens and OAuth apps are created in Settings > Apps. Docs describe no app review. Only Workspace owners or admins can create OAuth apps. All plans including Free Forever have API access (100 req/min).
record.api_breadth_notes: REST API v2, plus some v3 endpoints. Covers tasks, lists, folders, spaces, comments, time tracking, goals, custom fields, webhooks, docs, chat and more. Likely well over 100 operations; I didn't count them.
record.mcp_notes: https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp. Uses OAuth, and personal tokens are not accepted. Public beta, available on all plans.
record.blocker_notes: No blockers found. Rate limits are per token and depend on the plan: 100 req/min on Free, Unlimited and Business.

evidence.quote: Only Workspace owners or admins can create OAuth apps.
The ClickUp API applies rate limits per token
Each webhook event is signed with a shared secret that is unique to the webhook.
Public Beta: ClickUp's MCP server is currently in public beta

record.needs_human: The OpenAPI spec was not confirmed (the webhooks page doesn't mention one). The MCP details come from search snippets, not a fetched page. There is no confirmed sandbox. The auth page doesn't mention app review, but I didn't check for hidden restrictions on public distribution.
